svg.title: Supplement maximum levels in Europe
svg.desc: Type of national rule, checked 15 October 2026. Binding law: Belgium, France, Italy, Norway, Switzerland. Binding for some nutrients only: Netherlands (vitamins A and D), Sweden (vitamin D and iodine). Official guidance, not law: Germany, Austria, Ireland, United Kingdom. No national maximum: Spain, Finland.
